{{Quote|Ee escaped the remote Gree Enclave and was last seen on Tujiamoor shortly before the Talecalle volcanic eruptions.|Lecture by Doctor Corellia Antilles|<ref name="Files" />}}
'''Tujiamoor''' was an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] astronomical object. It was the site of the [[Talecalle volcano chain]]. Around [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Ils Ee]] visited Tujiamoor after [[Thief/Legends|stealing]] the [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] artifact known as the [[Sharka'k Noor]]. Shortly after that, the Talecalle [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]], which had remained dormant for 3,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]], suddenly [[Talecalle volcanic eruptions|erupted]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] 400,000 [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]]. Later, the [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologist]] [[Henrietya Antilles|Corellia Antilles]] speculated that it was the artifact that had activated the volcanoes on Tujiamoor.

==Description==
{{Quote|Assuming that Ee will try to master the Noor, interested parties should keep a close watch on seismic reports from planets near Tujiamoor.|Lecture by Doctor Corellia Antilles|<ref name="Files" />}}
Tujiamoor was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="Files" /> located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Tujiamoor system/Legends|Tujiamoor system]].<ref name="EAOC Tujiamoor" />

==History==
{{Quote|It seems reasonable to suspect that the Noor somehow activated the volcanoes.|Lecture by Doctor Corellia Antilles|<ref name="Files" />}}
[[File:SharkakNoor.png|thumb|right|200px|The Sharka'k Noor artifact was speculated by Corellia Antilles to have activated volcanoes on Tujiamoor.]]
Around [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Ils Ee]] [[Thief/Legends|stole]] the [[Sharka'k Noor]], a [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] artifact that allowed its user to manipulate the [[Geology|geologic]] activity of a [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] object. Ee then escaped from the<ref name="Files" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]]. Shortly thereafter, Tujiamoor's [[Talecalle volcano chain]] suddenly [[Talecalle volcanic eruptions|became active]], [[Death/Legends|claiming]] the lives of 400,000 [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]]. The eruptions caused significant confusion on Tujiamoor, and the resultant [[Magma/Legends|lava]] flow and [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] ash disrupted local [[space traffic control sensor]]s.<ref name="Files" />

In the following [[Standard month/Legends|month]], the [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologist]] Doctor [[Henrietya Antilles|Corellia Antilles]] gave a lecture at the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]] on<ref name="Files" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When discussing Ee's acquisition of the Noor, Antilles expressed her suspicion that the volcanoes on Tujiamoor had been activated by the artifact. The xenoarchaeologist further speculated that Ee could have survived the volcanic eruption and departed the astronomical object, which was the doctor's last known location, for nearby planets.<ref name="Files" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|Space traffic control sensors were disrupted by lava flow and volcanic ash, and Ee could have easily lifted off without being noticed.|Lecture by Doctor Corellia Antilles|<ref name="Files" />}}
Tujiamoor was settled at some point and was home to at least 400,000 colonists by 11 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]. [[Realspace/Legends|Space]] traffic control [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] monitored [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that departed the celestial body.<ref name="Files" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|The Talecalle volcano chain had been dormant for 3,000 years until it suddenly became active last month, killing 400,000 colonists.|Lecture by Doctor Corellia Antilles|<ref name="Files" />}}
Tujiamoor was the site of the Talecalle volcano chain, a series of volcanoes that had laid dormant for 3,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] by 11 ABY.<ref name="Files" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tujiamoor was created for the article "[[From the Files of Corellia Antilles]]," written by [[Timothy S. O'Brien|Timothy O'Brien]] and published in the [[August]] [[1997]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 14|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 14]].<ref name="Files" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Tujiamoor [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Tujiamoor itself, in grid square K-14.<ref name="TEA" />
